scripts.deploy: rm -rf node_modules/.cache && next build && next export && echo ryosuzuki.org > out/CNAME && touch out/.nojekyll && node scripts/create-deploy-tree.js && rsync -a --delete --exclude .git --exclude .gitignore deploy-out/ ../gh-pages/ && cd ../gh-pages && git add -A && git commit -m 'Update' && git push origin master && cd ../homepage
scripts.push: git subtree push --prefix out origin gh-pages
scripts.force: git push origin `git subtree split --prefix out master`:gh-pages --force
